Definition: Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt
BiblicalUsage: Tahpanhes or Tahapanes or Tehaphnehes = "thou will fill hands with pity"; 1) a city in Egypt; modern 'Tel Defenneh' or 'Tel Defneh' located approx 18 miles (29 km) east southeast from Tanis
